title: Procedural Coordination of Domain Entities
pattern: A batch coordinator or orchestration script loops over domain objects, calculates domain-specific metrics using their fields, and procedurally passes the results to other services.
why_bad: It treats domain entities as thin database wrappers and contains the actual business logic (interest calculation and posting rules) in a procedural script. This leads to an anemic domain model.
detection: A coordinator function that queries fields from type A and immediately pushes them to type B, performing calculations in between.
counterexample: `Context-dependent`. Thin integration controllers that only fetch and serialize data without containing calculation rules.
